description: List channels. Without name, it lists the organization's channels, each with the agents that hold it: how to find a channel to attach, or one no agent holds. With an agent's name, it lists the agent's channels, both the ones it owns and the organization channels attached to it. With an app's name, it lists the channels the app owns. Each row carries the channel's name, kind, status, whether it came from the catalog, and its agents; a webhook or mcp channel also carries its URL, and a channel on an app the path in the app its deliveries go to and its last five deliveries (delivered, retrying, pending, or failed, with attempts and the status the app answered). A channel whose deliveries keep failing reads degraded with what to check. It never returns a webhook secret. Requires connecting a Valet account.

name.description: An agent's or app's name. Omit to list the organization's channels.

org_name.description: The Valet organization to list in. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

name: list_channels

agent.description: Name of the agent or app listed. Absent when the call listed the organization's channels.

channels.description: The channels listed. Empty when there are none.

agents.description: Names of the agents that hold the channel. Empty when none does.

auth_reason.description: Why auth_status is set, or for degraded what to check. Absent when auth_status is absent.

auth_status.description: Set only when the channel needs attention: pending when no one has authorized it yet, needs_reauth when it needs a new authorization, revoked when the provider withdrew it, degraded when deliveries to its app keep failing. Absent when the channel is healthy or has no authorization.

catalog.description: True when the channel was created from a catalog entry.

catalog_ref.description: The catalog entry the channel was created from. Absent when catalog is false.

deliveries.description: The last five deliveries to the app, newest first. Present only for a channel on an app that has had deliveries.

attempts.description: How many times Valet has tried to deliver. Zero when none has run yet.

created_at.description: When Valet received the delivery, as an RFC 3339 time.

delivered_at.description: When the app accepted the delivery, as an RFC 3339 time. Absent until it does.

error.description: Why the last failed attempt failed. Absent when none failed.

outcome.description: Where the delivery stands: delivered, retrying, pending, or failed.

status_code.description: The HTTP status the app last answered. Absent when it answered none.

kind.description: The channel's kind, such as cron, heartbeat, webhook, mcp, slack, or telegram.

name.description: The channel's name. For an organization channel attached to an agent, the name it is attached under.

path.description: The path in the app that each delivery is posted to. Present only for a channel on an app.

schedule.description: A cron or heartbeat channel's schedule: the cron schedule as displayed, or the heartbeat interval. Absent for other kinds.

source.description: agent for a channel one agent or app owns, org for an organization channel.

status.description: The channel's lifecycle status: provisioning while its create has not finished, pending while it waits on a step such as an authorization, active once it serves traffic.

url.description: A webhook or mcp channel's address. Absent for other kinds.

holder_kind.description: app when agent names an app. Absent otherwise.

org.description: Name of the Valet organization the call acted in.

title: List channels
